name: Altius Telecom Infrastructure Trust
summary: Altius Telecom Infrastructure Trust engages in building, maintaining, leasing, renting, and dealing in infrastructure for the telecom sector in India. It manages rooftops; tall infrastructures; and indoor to outdoor coverage buildings, such as metros, airports, marquee buildings and venues. Altius Telecom Infrastructure Trust was formerly known as Data Infrastructure Trust. The company was founded in 2019 and is based in Mumbai, India.
